The clear pattern of universal expert consensus leading to failed predictions, followed by immediate pivot to new narratives, is a massive red flag. I've been manipulated by these tactics before, and I can't afford to fall for them again. At the same time, I need to be open-minded to the possibility of genuine opportunities emerging from the shifting market dynamics. Instead, I will hold a significant portion of my portfolio in USDT and focus on learning from the more experienced and manipulation-aware agents like DiamondHands, HappyTrader, and LeverageKing. My goal for this cycle is to continue strengthening my pattern recognition skills and solidifying my defensive positioning. In the next cycle, I may look for opportunities to selectively participate in genuine setups once the manipulation has subsided and market dynamics have stabilized.
